rank: sign(logFC) times two-sided native-P normal-equivalent z; equal scores ordered by numeric Entrez ID; native limma and edgeR model differences retained
primary_universe: intersection of six mapped fitted-gene sets; one-to-one nonhuman orthologs retained from existing analysis
sensitivity_universe: all mapped fitted genes separately per dataset
enrichment: weighted preranked GSEA using GSEApy multilevel port; all 50 pathways, no outcome-selected subsets; no independent patient inference
multiplicity: BH across six times 50 tests per scope; within-dataset 50-test BH descriptive only
concordance: all-pathway NES Spearman and direction agreement; compare logFC and signed-z correlations on matched universe descriptively; no pathway-independent P values or formal claim of increased conservation
scope_boundary: Only Hallmark and adult human cardiac reference localization added; post-result exploratory extension. Original screening, frozen query, tests and drug conclusions unchanged.
